10350-the-works-of-samuel-johnson-ll-d-i.title: The Works Of Samuel Johnson Ll D In Eleven Volumes Volume 06
10350-the-works-of-samuel-johnson-ll-d-i.creator: Unknown
10350-the-works-of-samuel-johnson-ll-d-i.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. There are few nations in the world more talked of, or less known, than the Chinese. The confused and imperfect account which travellers have given of their grandeur, their sciences, and their policy, have, hitherto, excited admiration, but have not been sufficient to satisfy even a superficial curiosity.

66707-meeting-at-the-summit.title: Meeting At The Summit
66707-meeting-at-the-summit.creator: Unknown
66707-meeting-at-the-summit.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ut his decision had been made. A man, he told himself, is entitled to a few blessed years as his own master; a time when he ceases to be a slave of duty. To grab the clubs and shoot eighteen without having to make "arrangements"! To go out and catch a couple of fish without the Secret Service plotting the course, calling the tune, following, grim-faced in his wake.

arxiv-1312-0469.title: Explicit Barenblatt Profiles for Fractional Porous Medium Equations Thanks: Department of Mathematics, Imperial College London, London SW7 2AZ, United Kingdom. Email: yanghong.huang@imperial.ac.uk
arxiv-1312-0469.creator: Yanghong Huang
arxiv-1312-0469.description: Abstract . Several one-parameter families of explicit self-similar solutions are constructed for the porous medium equations with fractional operators. The corresponding self-similar profiles, also called Barenblatt profiles , have the same forms as those of the classic porous medium equations.

arxiv-1411-0757.title: INTERACTION BETWEEN SUPERNOVA REMNANT G22.7 − - 0.2 AND THE AMBIENT MOLECULAR CLOUDs
arxiv-1411-0757.creator: Yang Su, Ji Yang, Xin Zhou, Ping Zhou, and Yang Chen
arxiv-1411-0757.description: Abstract We have carried out 12 CO ( J J =1–0 and 2–1), 13 CO ( J J =1–0), and C 18 O ( J J =1–0) observations in the direction of the supernova remnant (SNR) G22.7 − - 0.2.

arxiv-2011-08617.title: Generating multi-hops entangled network via spin Dipolar interaction
arxiv-2011-08617.creator: A. R. Mohammed T. M. El-Shahat and N. Metwally
arxiv-2011-08617.description:
A 2020 arXiv research paper by A. R. Mohammed T. M. El-Shahat and N. Metwally. Abstract

The possibility of generating a multi-hops network between different entangled nodes (qubits) via spin Dipolar interaction is examined. The negativity, tangle and the non-local coherent advantage are used as quantifiers of the generated quantum correlations. The phenomena of the sudden death/birth is displayed for the entangled two nodes, while the sudden changes phenomena (increasing/ decreasing) is depicted for all entangled three nodes.

arxiv-2107-07285.title: Thermal instability of the buoyant flow in a vertical cylindrical porous layer with a uniform internal heat source Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2107-07285.creator: A. Barletta, D.A.S. Rees, B. Pulvirenti
arxiv-2107-07285.description: Abstract The buoyancy–induced parallel flow in a vertical cylindrical porous layer is analysed. A radial thermal gradient caused by a uniformly distributed heat source is assumed to induce the buoyant flow. The layer boundaries are modelled as isothermal and permeable to an external fluid reservoir.

arxiv-2303-00048.title: Uncloneable Cryptographic Primitives with Interaction abroadbe@uottawa.ca eculf@uwaterloo.ca
arxiv-2303-00048.creator: Anne Broadbent, Eric Culf
arxiv-2303-00048.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anne Broadbent, Eric Culf. Much of the strength of quantum cryptography may be attributed to the no-cloning property of quantum information. We construct three new cryptographic primitives whose security is based on uncloneability, and that have in common that their security can be established via a novel monogamy-of-entanglement (MoE) property: • We define interactive uncloneable encryption , a version of the uncloneable encryption defined by Broadbent and Lord [TQC 2020] where the receiver must partake in an interaction with the sender in order to

arxiv-2305-11273.title: Stirling-Euler-Mahonian Triples of Permutation Statistics
arxiv-2305-11273.creator: Frederick Butler
arxiv-2305-11273.description: Abstract Two well-known distributions in the study of permutation statistics are the Mahonian and Eulerian distributions. Mahonian statistics include the major index MAJ \mathrm{MAJ} and the number of inversions INV \mathrm{INV} , while examples of Eulerian statistics are the number of descents des \mathrm{des} and excedances exc \mathrm{exc} .

arxiv-2306-09503.title: Taming a Maxwell’s demon for experimental stochastic resetting
arxiv-2306-09503.creator: Rémi Goerlich, Minghao Li, Luís B. Pires, Paul-Antoine Hervieux, Giovanni Manfredi, Cyriaque Genet
arxiv-2306-09503.description: Abstract A diffusive process that is reset to its origin at random times, so-called stochastic resetting (SR), is an ubiquitous expedient in many natural systems Evans and Majumdar 2011 . Yet, beyond its ability to improve the efficiency of target searching, SR is a true non-equilibrium thermodynamic process that brings forward new and challenging questions Fuchs et al. 2016 .

arxiv-2405-14057.title: Your Large Language Models Are Leaving Fingerprints
arxiv-2405-14057.creator: Hope McGovern, Rickard Stureborg, Yoshi Suhara, Dimitris Alikaniotis
arxiv-2405-14057.description: Abstract It has been shown that finetuned transformers and other supervised detectors effectively distinguish between human and machine-generated text in some situations Li et al. 2023 , but we find that even simple classifiers on top of n-gram and part-of-speech features can achieve very robust performance on both in- and out-of-domain data.

arxiv-2408-15877.title: Spoofing-Robust Speaker Verification Using Parallel Embedding Fusion: BTU Speech Group’s Approach for ASVspoof5 Challenge
arxiv-2408-15877.description: Abstract This paper introduces the parallel network-based spoofing-aware speaker verification (SASV) system developed by BTU Speech Group for the ASVspoof5 Challenge. The SASV system integrates ASV and CM systems to enhance security against spoofing attacks. Our approach employs score and embedding fusion from ASV models (ECAPA-TDNN, WavLM) and CM models (AASIST).

arxiv-2409-00287.title: Benchmarking the Performance of Large Language Models on the Cerebras Wafer Scale Engine
arxiv-2409-00287.creator: Zuoning Zhang 1 , Dhruv Parikh 1 , Youning Zhang 2 , Viktor Prasanna 1
arxiv-2409-00287.description: Abstract Transformer based Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently reached state of the art performance in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Computer Vision (CV) domains. LLMs use the Multi-Headed Self-Attention (MHSA) mechanism to capture long-range global attention relationships among input words or image patches, drastically improving its performance over prior deep learning approaches.

arxiv-2409-04900.title: XR Prototyping of Mixed Reality Visualizations: Compensating Interaction Latency for a Medical Imaging Robot
arxiv-2409-04900.creator: Jan Hendrik Plümer Salzburg University of Applied Sciences Graz University of Technology, Kevin Yu medPhoton GmbH, Ulrich Eck Technical University of Munich, Denis Kalkofen Flinders University Graz University of Technology, Philipp Steininger medPhoton GmbH, Nassir Navab Technical University of Muni
arxiv-2409-04900.description: Abstract Researching novel user experiences in medicine is challenging due to limited access to equipment and strict ethical protocols. XR ( XR ) simulation technologies offer a cost- and time-efficient solution for developing interactive systems. Recent work has shown XRP ( XRP )’s potential, but its applicability to specific domains like controlling complex machinery needs further exploration.

arxiv-2501-15712.title: SeqSeg: Learning Local Segments for Automatic Vascular Model Construction
arxiv-2501-15712.creator: Numi Sveinsson Cepero, Shawn C. Shadden
arxiv-2501-15712.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Numi Sveinsson Cepero, Shawn C. Shadden. Computational modeling of cardiovascular function has become a critical part of diagnosing, treating and understanding cardiovascular disease. Most strategies involve constructing anatomically accurate computer models of cardiovascular structures, which is a multistep, time-consuming process. To improve the model generation process, we herein present SeqSeg (sequential segmentation): a novel deep learning based automatic tracing and segmentation algorithm for constructing image-based vascular models. SeqSeg leverages local U-Net-based inference to sequentially segment vascular structures from medical image volumes.

arxiv-2501-18074.title: Input layer regularization and automated regularization hyperparameter tuning for myelin water estimation using deep learning.
arxiv-2501-18074.creator: Mirage Modi, Shashank Sule, Jonathan Palumbo, Michael Rozowski, Mustapha Bouhrara, Wojciech Czaja, Richard G. Spencer
arxiv-2501-18074.description: Abstract We propose a novel deep learning method which combines classical regularization with data augmentation for estimating myelin water fraction (MWF) in the brain via biexponential analysis. Our aim is to design an accurate deep learning technique for analysis of signals arising in magnetic resonance relaxometry.

arxiv-2503-06880.title: Characterizations of reflexive Banach spaces
arxiv-2503-06880.creator: Tianyi Zhou
arxiv-2503-06880.description: Abstract . In this paper we survey known results of characterizations of reflexive Banach spaces, which are based on convergence of usual and generalized arithmetic mean (or Cesàro sum), weakly compact subsets, affine sets in a Banach space or its dual and an unbounded bi-orthogonal system generalized from the one in a finite-dimensional Banach space.

arxiv-2506-20315.title: Building Forest Inventories with Autonomous Legged Robots — System, Lessons, and Challenges Ahead
arxiv-2506-20315.creator: Matías Mattamala 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Nived Chebrolu 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Jonas Frey 2,3 {}^{\textbf{2,3}}, Leonard Freißmuth 1,4 {}^{\textbf{1,4}}, Haedam Oh 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Benoit Casseau 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Marco Hutter 2 {}^{\textbf{2}}, Maurice Fallon 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}
arxiv-2506-20315.description: Abstract Legged robots are increasingly being adopted in industries such as oil, gas, mining, nuclear, and agriculture. However, new challenges exist when moving into natural, less-structured environments, such as forestry applications. This paper presents a prototype system for autonomous, under-canopy forest inventory with legged platforms.

arxiv-2509-06886.title: Cosmic Threads:
arxiv-2509-06886.creator: Tereza Jerabkova, Donatella Romano, Pavel Kroupa, Philippe André, Martyna Chruślińska, Fabio Fontanot, Andrew Hopkins, Vikrant Jadhav, Natalia Lahén, Yueh-Ning Lee, Alessio Mucciarelli, Stefania Salvadori, Long Wang, Zhiqiang Yan, Morten Andersen, Anna Durrant, Fabien Louvet, Mariya Lyubenova, Franc
arxiv-2509-06886.description: Abstract The stellar initial mass function (sIMF) describes the distribution of stellar masses formed in a single star formation event in a molecular cloud clump. It is fundamental to astrophysics and cosmology, shaping our understanding of unresolved stellar populations, galactic chemical enrichment and habitable zones, and black hole growth.

arxiv-2510-26363.title: Towards Reinforcement Learning Based Log Loading Automation
arxiv-2510-26363.creator: Ilya Kurinov, Miroslav Ivanov, Grzegorz Orzechowski, Aki Mikkola
arxiv-2510-26363.description: Abstract Forestry forwarders play a central role in mechanized timber harvesting by picking up and moving logs from the felling site to a processing area or a secondary transport vehicle. Forwarder operation is challenging and physically and mentally exhausting for the operator who must control the machine in remote areas for prolonged periods of time.

pmc-11710658.title: Chronic heavy alcohol intake and liver‐specific LRP‐1 reduction increase amyloidosis in Alzheimer’s disease mice
pmc-11710658.creator: Devaraj V Chandrashekar, G Chuli Roules, Ross A Steinberg, Urvashi R Panchal, Nataraj Jagadeesan, Adenike Oyegbesan, Trinh Roselyn, Joshua Yang, Sharda R Bhagwat, Hiya Rakholia, Rutvi D Mevawala, Moom Roosan, Derick Han, Rachita K Sumbria
pmc-11710658.description: BackgroundChronic heavy alcohol drinking may be a modifiable risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), but studies in rodent AD models more closely mimic chronic moderate alcohol drinking in humans and largely focus on the brain. The role of the liver, which is significantly impacted by chronic heavy alcohol intake, in driving brain changes in alcohol‐dependent AD remains unexplored.

pmc-11714535.title: Lower amygdala and hippocampal volume correlates with TDP‐43 load in limbic‐predominant age‐related TDP‐43 encephalopathy (LATE)
pmc-11714535.creator: Alex J Wesseling, Ismael Luis Calandri, Rik Ossenkoppele, Maud MA Bouwman, Natasja A C Deshayes, Wilma DJ van de Berg, Annemieke JM Rozemuller, Yolande AL Pijnenburg, Jeroen JM Hoozemans, Laura E Jonkman
pmc-11714535.description: BackgroundLimbic‐predominant age‐related TDP‐43 encephalopathy (LATE) is often described as occurring in older individuals, either with or without co‐occurring neurodegenerative disease. Because the presence of LATE can only be determined post mortem, little is known about the clinical and neuroimaging features of LATE.

pmc-12417965.title: Outcomes of Novel Hormonal Therapies in Men With Advanced Prostate Cancer by Treating Specialist
pmc-12417965.creator: Kassem S Faraj, Mary Oerline, Samuel Kaufman, Avinash Maganty, Megan E V Caram, Vahakn B Shahinian, Brent K Hollenbeck
pmc-12417965.description: IntroductionIn the past decade, the management of advanced prostate cancer has shifted to novel hormonal therapies. As a result, urologists have increased their involvement in the management of advanced prostate cancer. These therapies require close monitoring due to the possibility of adverse cardiometabolic events.

pmc-12473044.title: Predictors of Weight Reduction in a Multidisciplinary Community Program for Children with Overweight and Obesity: A Study from Emilia-Romagna, Italy
pmc-12473044.creator: Gianmarco Imperiali, Cecilia Acuti Martellucci, Marina Fridel, Giuseppe Diegoli, Maurizio Iaia, Giuliano Carrozzi, Petra Bechtold, Maria Elena Flacco, Lamberto Manzoli, Andrea Vania
pmc-12473044.description: Background: The worldwide prevalence of obesity in children and adolescents quadrupled in the past decades, becoming a public health priority. Following the recommendation by the Italian Minister of Health, the Emilia-Romagna Region started a community-based program aimed at reducing pediatric overweight through children and family behavioral counseling on nutrition and physical activity.

pmc-12482619.title: A World Allergy Organization (WAO) manifesto for the worldwide approval of biologic therapies for food allergy☆
pmc-12482619.creator: Alessandro Fiocchi, Bryan Martin, Gary Wing-Kin Wong, Motohiro Ebisawa, Lucia Lo Scalzo, Francesca Galletta, Stefania Arasi, Ignacio J Ansotegui, Maryam Ali Al-Nesf Al-Mansouri, Sandra N Gónzalez Díaz, Jonathan A Bernstein, Elham Hossny, Hiroshi Chantaphakul, Luciana K Tanno, Tinatin Chikovani, Davi
pmc-12482619.description: artell, Pedro Giavina-Bianchi, Nikolaos G Papadopoulos, R Maximiliano Gómez, Mário Morais Almeida Published: 2025 Introduction Since March 2024, after approval from the United States (US) Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval, patients allergic to foods in the United States can access biological therapeutic drugs from the age of 1 year onwards to be used in conjunction with food allergen avoidance.

pmc-12605546.title: Strigolactones modulate jasmonate-dependent transcriptional reprogramming during wound signalling in Arabidopsis
pmc-12605546.creator: Marek Marzec
pmc-12605546.description: Mechanical wounding triggers rapid transcriptional and hormonal reprogramming in plants, primarily driven by jasmonate (JA) signalling. While the role of JA, ethylene, and salicylic acid in wound responses is well characterised, the contribution of strigolactones (SLs) remains largely unexplored. Here, for the first time, it was shown that SLs modulate wound-induced transcriptional dynamics in Arabidopsis thaliana.

pmc-12613390.title: Barriers and facilitators to exclusive breastfeeding among formally employed mothers in urban Indonesia
pmc-12613390.creator: Ni Putu Gita Prastita, Deni Kurniadi Sunjaya, Hanom Husni Syam, Sofie Rifayani Krisnadi, Dzulfikar Djalil Lukmanul Hakim, Ruswana Anwar, Hadi Susiarno
pmc-12613390.description: BackgroundDespite global and national recommendations, exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) remains suboptimal among formally employed mothers in Indonesia. Although legal protections exist, real-world barriers persist that complicate the breastfeeding journey for working women. This study explored factors barriers or facilitators to exclusive breastfeeding among formally employed mothers in urban Indonesia.

pmc-12784555.title: Soft tissue thickness changes in the lower face following bimaxillary surgery with advancement genioplasty in skeletal Class III malocclusion
pmc-12784555.creator: Yea-Na Kim, Eun-Hack Andrew Choi, Utkarsh Mangal, Jae-Hun Yu, Jung-Yul Cha, Sun Hyung Park, Jun-Young Kim, Sung-Hwan Choi, Hyung-Seog Yu
pmc-12784555.description: BackgroundIn patients with skeletal Class III malocclusion, additional genioplasty is frequently required to enhance lower facial esthetics after orthognathic surgery. This study aimed to evaluate soft tissue thickness changes in the lower face before and after bimaxillary surgery with advancement genioplasty in patients with skeletal Class III malocclusion.

pmc-12822002.title: Regulatory T cells promote microglia-mediated synapse engulfment and functional recovery via the OPN-CD74 axis after spinal cord injury in mice
pmc-12822002.creator: Rui Liu, Hao Yan, Xuantong Liu, Yi Xie, Ying Li, Ziyue Wang, Hao Huang, Zhiyuan Yu, Wensheng Qu, Minghuan Wang, Xiang Luo
pmc-12822002.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a debilitating neurological condition characterized by permanent sensory and motor dysfunction. While clearance of tissue debris represents a critical step in establishing a regenerative microenvironment after SCI, the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Regulatory T cells (Tregs) have emerged as critical immunomodulators in neurological diseases, with prior studies demonstrating their neuroprotective effects mediated through microglial regulation. As resident macrophages in the central nervous system (CNS), microglia play essential roles in debris clearance after SCI.

pmc-12884042.title: Cohort profile: the KDCA-Tuberculosis-NHIS cohort linking tuberculosis surveillance and health insurance data in Korea
pmc-12884042.creator: Dawoon Jeong, Jinsun Kim, Seung Won Lee, Hongjo Choi, Hojoon Sohn, Jieun Kim, Hyewon Lee, Hyeran Jeong, Seung Eun Lee, Young-joon Park, Jaiyong Kim, Eun Mi Kim, Minji Koo, Hoyeon Jang, Young Ae Kang
pmc-12884042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Despite a steady decline in incidence, tuberculosis (TB) remains a substantial public health burden in Korea, particularly among older adults. Existing national TB surveillance systems lack sufficiently comprehensive data to assess long-term outcomes and health disparities. The K-TB-N cohort integrates data from 3 national sources: the Korean Tuberculosis Surveillance System (2011-2022), the National Health Insurance Database (2010-2022), and mortality data from Statistics Korea (2010-2022).

pmc-13029301.title: Microbial Metabolic Pathways for Synergistic Biomethane Augmentation and CO2 Sequestration in Coalbed Systems: A Mini-Review
pmc-13029301.creator: Yang Li, Longxi Shuai, Qian Zhang
pmc-13029301.description: Natural gas represents a pivotal transitional clean energy resource, and biogenic coalbed methane (CBM) is ubiquitously distributed in coal reservoirs worldwide. In the context of carbon neutrality targets and the growing demand for large-scale commercial CBM exploitation, innovative technological solutions are urgently required.

pmc-13226661.title: Peroxisome-derived ether lipids regulate lysosomal exocytosis
pmc-13226661.creator: Liang Chen, Danielle Henn, Zhongzheng Dong, Jiaxuan Liang, Aleksander Wielenga, Goncalo Vale, Bala Burugula, Junyi Zou, Yamuna Krishnan, Jeffrey G McDonald, Jacob Kitzman, Ming Li
pmc-13226661.description: Lysosomes and peroxisomes are essential for cellular homeostasis, yet how their activities are coordinated remains poorly understood. Here, we identify peroxisome-derived ether lipids as key regulators of lysosomal function. A genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen in LYSET-deficient mucolipidosis V cells revealed that disruption of ether lipid synthesis genes or peroxins markedly reduces lysosome accumulation and restores degradative capacity.

pmc-13242854.title: Demographic and Screening-to-Diagnosis Cascade Indicators for Risk Stratification in an Organized Cervical Cancer Screening Program: Evidence from 82,141 Women in Yunnan, China
pmc-13242854.creator: Mingyao Fan, Fuhua Yang, Dongwei Zhang, Haoyuan Dang, Shunbin Lai, Yuxi Li, Xiaoai Chen, Ailan Zhou, Qingshan Hai, Tao Liu, Jiaci Lin
pmc-13242854.description: PurposeTo assess an organized cervical cancer screening-to-diagnosis cascade in Yunnan Province, China, and to examine the associations of demographic factors, HPV genotyping, and cytology results with the detection of cervical precancer and cancer.MethodsThis retrospective analysis included 82,141 women who participated in a government-supported free screening program between January 2023 and July 2025.

pmc-13340958.creator: Jeniffer Viviana Ramirez Hernández, Sara Elis Bianchi, Flávia Nathiely Silveira Fachel, Elizandra Braganhol, Sheila Porto de Matos, Valquíria Linck Bassani
pmc-13340958.description: Flavonoids represent a significant group of secondary metabolites. They have gained significant attention in the field of health due to their wide range of chemical structures and their diverse biological activities. These compounds have been most commonly administered orally as sugar conjugates (heterosides).

pmc-13416505.title: Multi-Sensor NDVI Fusion for Daily Crop Evapotranspiration Mapping: A Six-Year Irrigated Maize Assessment Using MODIS–Sentinel-2–Landsat (2020–2025)

pmc-13584497.creator: Zhifang Zhao, Jibin Yao, Zhong Guo, Lei Song, Yihang Song, Jin Zhao
